raw_response:
I do what my mother taught me. I put manure from my goats and chickens on this rice plot because it is my own land, and I keep seed from last season — I do not trust those new seeds from the shops that cost too much. I will not buy chemical fertilizer or spray because I am an old woman with little cash, and my grandchildren and daughters will do the work so I do not pay workers. I wait for the rains from God; I have no way to bring water myself.
